newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee closes up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.02 up at 40.11 to the dollar in the kerb market on Thursday in dull trading after its devaluation by the central bank on Tuesday, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open higher on low demand from traders, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on Tuesday, stood at 36.9700/37.1549.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.70 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
